newsitem.title: USA: Muni sales to total $20 mln for week of Dec 23.
newsitem.headline: Muni sales to total $20 mln for week of Dec 23.

text.p: Scheduled competitive and negotiated municipal bond sales for the week of December 23 have been revised and are now expected to total $20 million in five offerings, according to Reuters Municipal Bond Information Group.
Competitive sales total $5.6 million in three issues. The largest issue is a $2.9 million Janesville, Wis., issue on December 23 at 1200 EST.
Negotiated sales total $15 million in two offerings. The largest negotiated issue had been a $63 million New York State Environmental Facilities Corp offering, which was priced on Friday instead.
Eleven issue totaling $406 million are on Reuters possible negotiated calendar, meaning underwriters have said they may price the deals during the week depending on market conditions.
